whatIs.a: DResume is an AI-powered platform that helps you score, build, and optimize your resume, generate cover letters, estimate salary, research companies, and prepare for interviews — all powered by Claude AI and tailored for the job market, with English and Vietnamese support.

createAccount.q: How do I create an account?
createAccount.a: Click "Get Started" or "Register", enter your name, email, and a password, then verify your email via the link we send you. Once verified, you can sign in and start using all the tools.

freeVsPaid.q: What's the difference between Free, Pro, and Premium?
freeVsPaid.a: Free includes a limited number of resume scores per month plus basic cover letters and job matching. Pro unlocks unlimited scores, the AI Resume Builder, salary estimator, and interview coaching. Premium adds unlimited everything, priority AI processing, and the Career Coach roadmap. See the pricing section on the landing page for the latest details.

languages.a: Yes. You can switch between English and Vietnamese using the language switcher in the top bar, and the AI automatically detects and responds in the language of your resume or input.

howScoring.a: Upload your resume and our AI analyzes it the way a recruiter and an applicant tracking system would, then returns a score with specific, actionable feedback on what to improve.

ats.q: What is an ATS and why does it matter?
ats.a: An Applicant Tracking System (ATS) is software many companies use to filter resumes before a human reads them. Our scoring checks formatting, keywords, and structure so your resume is more likely to pass these filters.

improveScore.q: How can I improve my score?
improveScore.a: Follow the tips in your score report — typically adding relevant keywords, quantifying achievements, fixing formatting, and aligning your resume with the target role. Re-score after editing to see your progress.

fileTypes.q: Which file types can I upload?
fileTypes.a: You can upload PDF, DOCX, and TXT files. For best results, use a clean, text-based file rather than a scanned image.

howBuilder.q: How does the AI Resume Builder work?
howBuilder.a: Enter your details — work history, education, skills — and the AI generates a polished, professional resume for you. You can then refine the content and tailor it to specific jobs.

editResume.q: Can I edit the AI-generated resume?
editResume.a: Yes. Everything the AI produces is fully editable. Review and adjust the wording, add or remove sections, and personalize it before you use it.

tailorJob.q: Can I tailor my resume to a specific job?
tailorJob.a: Yes. Use the "improve for job" option to optimize your resume against a specific job description, or run Job Match to see how well it aligns and where to close the gaps.

jobMatch.q: What does Job Match Analysis do?
jobMatch.a: Paste a job description and your resume, and the AI shows how well you match, highlights missing skills and keywords, and suggests how to strengthen your application.

coverLetter.q: How do I generate a cover letter?
coverLetter.a: Provide your resume and the job details, choose a tone, and the AI drafts a tailored cover letter in seconds that you can edit before sending.

salary.q: How accurate is the Salary Estimator?
salary.a: The estimate is based on your role, experience, and location to give a realistic range. Treat it as a well-informed guide for negotiations rather than a guarantee.

interview.q: What does the Interview Coach include?
interview.a: It generates likely interview questions, model answers and tips, and a personalized preparation plan based on your target role.

career.a: The Career Coach (Premium) builds a strategic roadmap with a skill-development plan and job-search strategy, plus goals and tasks you can track in the calendar view.

plans.q: How do I upgrade my plan?
plans.a: Go to your Account page and choose Pro or Premium. You can pay by card or, where available, by bank transfer, and your new features unlock as soon as payment is confirmed.

paymentMethods.a: We accept credit/debit cards through our secure payment processor, and bank transfer for supported plans. Card details are handled by the processor and never stored on our servers.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Open your Account page and cancel from the billing panel. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period, after which it won't renew.

refund.a: Except where required by law, subscription payments are non-refundable. You can cancel anytime to stop future charges. See the Terms of Service for details.

changePassword.q: How do I change my password?
changePassword.a: Use the "Forgot password" link on the login page to receive a reset email, or update it from your Account settings while signed in.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: You can request account deletion from your Account settings. We remove your personal data within a reasonable period, except where retention is legally required.

privacy.a: We use encrypted authentication, secure storage, and access controls to protect your data, and we never sell your resume content. See the Privacy Policy for full details on how your data is handled.
